The main takeaway from our work is that

the stable oxygen isotope composition of planktonic and benthic foraminiferal tests from the Tyrrhenium Sea is a good proxy for the oxygen isotopic composition of the ambient seawater, and that it is possible to reconstruct the history of Mediterranean Sea level change from the stable oxygen isotopic composition of foraminiferal calcite.
